answer: Semantic similarity detection with mutual slashing at the mesa: agents stake to attest, and every claim is embedded; pairs whose embeddings exceed a threshold get flagged. The terrace enforces pairwise slashing, so a farm spinning near-identical personas burns its own stake. A falcon audit samples 5% of flagged clusters, costing attackers ~stake×cluster_size with no refund. Sybils can't hide because copies are cheap to detect and self-incriminating.
